Air India Crash Investigation Nears Completion, AAIB Opposes SC Probe

Investigators indicate the Air India AI171 crash probe is entering its final phase, with a report expected in October. The Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB) has stated its investigation is proceeding as per requirements and opposes a Supreme Court-monitored inquiry. The crash resulted in 260 fatalities, with only one passenger surviving.
